source.title: On some open problems in planar differential systems and Hilbert's 16th problem

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH URL with identifier 5265039. Local resolver metadata identifies the work as 'On some open problems in planar differential systems and Hilbert's 16th problem', published in Chaos, Solitons & Fractals 31(5), pages 1118-1134, 2007, with DOI 10.1016/j.chaos.2005.10.057.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted. Direct local fetching of zbmath.org failed because the sandbox could not resolve or connect to the host. Exact-work recovery by zbMATH identifier, DOI, title plus PDF, and ScienceDirect PII S0960077905010337 found only metadata or restricted pages. ScienceDirect exposed an abstract and section snippet but not the full article body; IDEAS marked the ScienceDirect full text as subscriber-only; ResearchGate marked the item as request-only with no full text. Other recovered pages were citations, references, or different works and were rejected.

No accepted questions were extracted because the workflow could not recover a readable full-text PDF or HTML source for the same exact work, and the contract forbids extracting open problems from abstracts, citation metadata, search snippets, or related papers.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/5265039.json and outputs/latest.json.
